snippet.title: Out of the Park Baseball 27 - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Out of the Park Baseball 27 launches worldwide on March 13, 2026! The beloved baseball strategy game enjoyed by fans around the world is back for its 27th season of excellence.

Pre-order today, play it three days early and save 10% right now at https://www.ootpdevelopments.com/ootp-pre-order/

OR 

Wishlist on Steam! The Steam page is coming soon!
